title: Triage dropped its assigned task by asserting an unverified negative — zero reads of the assigned id's Scout occurrences
summary: Cycle-1571 audit H1 (re-confirmed): triage asserted the assigned todo-id was absent/invalid without reading its input — the audit's evidence shows zero Triage reads while the assigned id appears seven times in the Scout report. Residual carved out of ship-review-binding-fails-open (0.86), whose headline defect (binding fail-open) was fixed console-side in PR #503 and whose H2 (goal-text red-first insurance backfire) was resolved by retiring the clause from wave goals. This H1 half needs its own fix: a triage-phase contract that the assigned id set is grounded in the scout report before a drop/negative disposition is permitted (e.g. the drop rationale must cite the scout lines consulted, deterministically checkable), plus a regression fixture from cycle-1571's artifacts.
